Environment note: a pnpm reinstall runs postinstall migrate deploy, which fails with 'database is locked' while the live Play preview (port 3543) holds data/fitpulse.db. This QA run did not reinstall, and the e2e webServer uses a temp workspace database (tests/e2e/global-setup.ts), so the owner's data was not touched.
